name: Thousand Days Later
source:
Forgotten island in the middle of the ocean. Paradise for common man, prison for victim of a plane crash, and home - for Jack, who lives here almost three years. Every night he sees the same dream. A nightmare of a horror, which happened thousand days ago...

[From [url=https://ns-studio.itch.io/tdl-demo2]Itch.io[/url]]

Remake of [url=/v23699]Thousand Days Later[/url] with new art, scenario and music, extra characters and endings etc.
translation:
大洋中央被遗忘的岛屿。普通人的天堂，空难受害者的监狱，以及在这里生活了近三年的杰克的家。每天晚上他都会做同样的梦。一场恐怖的噩梦，发生在几千天前……

[来自[url=https://ns-studio.itch.io/tdl-demo2]Itch.io[/url]]

重拍[url=/v23699]千日之后[/url]，添加了新的美术、场景和音乐、额外的角色和结局等。
